trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 1785909.

Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/1785909 returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge. Local shell fetches of api.zbmath.org and oai.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors, while browser access to those API/OAI roots exposed only terms/challenge entry pages rather than record metadata.

Local workflow shard metadata for the same zbMATH identifier records the title as 'Eighteen open problems in C_p-theory' and the year as 1997, but it does not provide a readable full-text link. This metadata was used only for title recovery, not technical extraction.

Ran exact-work recovery attempts using the zbMATH identifier, exact title, exact title plus PDF, and exact title plus 1997. A Math-Net.Ru PDF was inspected because search surfaced it for related C_p-theory open-question text, but its visible source title is 'Some recent advances and open problems in general topology', not the exact recovered title, so it was rejected as an ambiguous/different work. Other recovered candidates were search snippets, unrelated numeric hits, or metadata-only pages.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered. The workflow forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, local shard rows, abstracts, search snippets, or a candidate whose visible title does not confirm the same exact source.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-1785909.json and outputs/latest.json.
